skillTree.localised_description: A small handful of Gnoblars surround this Ogre Lord, their swords always ready to cut and carve.
Stumpy and short-witted as they are, these Gnoblars have an eye on the sky at all times.
It never hurts to keep your lucky Gnoblar with you, just in case.
Puny magicks are nothing in the face of the Great Maw's endless hunger.
A Bellower’s voice is as deep as it loud, carrying across the battlefield and encouraging unbridled carnage.
Having learned much in their long years of service, this character now turns their attention to training others.

skillTree.localised_description: Endurance is the law of the mountain. Under Hrothgul’s rule, the frost shields his warriors, ensuring they fight long after others would fall.
The frozen peaks do not welcome intruders-those who trespass find their limbs sluggish, their strength drained by the biting cold.
To those who call the mountains home, ice is no obstacle but an ally. With the storm at their backs, they move as swiftly as the howling wind.
Neither fear nor steel can break him. Hrothgul stands defiant, his body hardened by ice and his will unshaken by death itself.

related_attributes.bullet_text: The unit is immune to psychological attacks (Fear & Terror).

skillTree.localised_description: In the presence of their king, the Greybacks fight with the fury of the endless winter, striking harder and enduring longer.

skillTree.localised_description: The cold clings to his every step, spreading like an unspoken oath to those who fight beside him. As he charges into battle, the ice takes hold.
A final, freezing breath before the kill-Hrothgul unleashes a blast of razor-sharp frost, tearing through those who stand before him.

related_attributes.bullet_text: This unit can never have its Melee Attack reduced during battle.

skillTree.localised_description: No enemy is immovable when in the path of a furious Ogre's charge.
This warrior is one with their blade; it is an extension of their will, making them a worthy foe in combat.
This Ogre's greed shall never be sated, for his stomach is as endless as his hunger.
A truly sturdy armour is needed to hold such an overflowing gut in place.
Such is their power and ferocity, a wound-maker will ravage the foe, cutting and pulverising until there is only one exit - death.
From one bloodied, lifeless corpse to the next, this one is always looking for the next adversary to best.
If the enormous size of this Ogre doesn't incite terror, his bloody, malevolent smile surely will.

related_attributes.bullet_text: This unit can cause terror, making its melee target rout for a short time. Units that cause terror are immune to terror and fear themselves.

skillTree.localised_description: The scars on this storied warrior reveal a veteran of many battles, a being not easy to kill and one worthy of respect and fear.
Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.
Some creatures charge home with such fury that the very ground shakes beneath their feet.
This Tyrant is the size of several large creatures rolled into one. In fact, he ate those several large creatures just yesterday.
Mountains of gold and an overflowing meat-pot are bound to draw in the strongest of warriors.

Allows the unit to attack and destroy walls in melee. This attribute also adds a  +50% damage multiplier against buildings.

factionEffects.localised_description: High upon the frozen peaks of the Tusk, where the air is thin and the cold is merciless, dwell the Sons of the Mountain-a tribe of Ogres who have embraced the harshness of their domain. Cloaked in ice and adorned with the bones of their kills, they fight with the fury of a winter storm, crushing all who dare trespass upon their sacred frostbound domain.
